**RULE: RUN MERGE with a 1 s gap cap (a record >1 s after the previous starts a new print), side = last-vs-bid/ask, close time = min(next print's time, last record + 1 s). CAUSAL, needs a 1 s timer.**

**Set suffix: `_CANG`** (sets TL3_ALN_NY_L488784d8_CANG).
